svg.title: The frame of a call
svg.desc: Three regions. Tag 1, the module's namespace, holds the name drive_time. Tag 2, the namespace of the call drive_time(3.0, 0.25), holds the names distance_m, speed_mps and time_s. Tag 3 holds the objects: the function drive_time and the floats 3.0, 0.25 and 12.0. Each name has an arrow to its object.
